'''Enhanced Premiere Rules Notes''' (November 1998) for [[Enhanced Premiere]].

== Permanent weapon ==

[[File:Icon-permanent-weapon.png|50px|Permanent weapon icon]] Your Enhanced Premiere premium character card is armed with a [[Permanent Weapon|permanent character weapon]]. Such a weapon may not be separated from the character (lost, stolen, transferred, retrieved etc.) except by cards that deploy on the character as a marker (for example, [[Disarmed]]). If such a marker card is removed, the weapon is restored.

Game text that relocates weapons (for example, to or from a pile) may not be used to relocate this character card, unless that game text also relocates characters.

== Defense value ==

'''Defense value''' is a collective term which now refers to the various attributes used when cards are targeted by weapons. A [[Character|character]]’s defense value is its ability or armor, whichever is higher. (Unarmored [[Droid|droids]] have a defense value of zero.) A [[Vehicle|vehicle]] or [[Starship|starship]]’s defense value is its armor or maneuver. A [[Creature|creature]]’s defense value is unique to that creature, such as scales, slither, vicious howl etc.
